nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 下北泽的唱片店还有十五分钟打烊。店主从一箱旧磁带里找到一首没有歌名、没有乐队名的 demo，只贴着一张写有 B-side 的标签。

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: The shop owner wants to return it to the musicians. We have one song and three clues hidden in the lyrics.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 副歌唱到：last train, basement light, and a paper moon above the stage。附近恰好有三家 live house。

options.text: 「Could the 'paper moon' be a venue logo?」
「Maybe we should search for the song title.」

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: Nice. Lyrics can describe a real place without naming it. One venue nearby has a crescent logo.

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: There is no title, remember? Let's turn the images in the lyrics into searchable details.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你们赶到月牙标志的地下演出厅。检票员记得这段旋律，却不确定能不能透露乐手的联系方式。

options.text: 「Could you pass our message to them instead?」
「Please give us their phone number. It's important.」

nodes.speaker: 检票员
nodes.text: That I can do. Leave your name and the shop's number; I'll let the band decide.

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: We shouldn't ask for private details. Ask him to forward the message and let the musicians choose.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 回到唱片店时，电话正好响起。三位早已解散的乐手听见那段 demo，在听筒另一端同时笑了起来。

nodes.speaker: 店主
nodes.text: They say the song never had a name. Since you found its way home, they want you to name it.

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: Perfect. It travelled for years, but tonight it caught the last train home.

nodes.speaker: Aki
nodes.text: Perfect. Two small clues, now holding the whole memory together.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 店主把名字写上标签，将磁带放进橱窗最中央。打烊灯熄灭前，B 面终于有了自己的位置。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 120 金币】你带走一张空白磁带，也带走了尊重边界的另一种表达方式。
